summary: Build practical court filing, caseflow, and records skills in 5 days. Learn digital court administration methods you can apply immediately.
lede: Digital court administration training helps court operations and legal support professionals manage electronic filings, case records and hearing workflows with consistent controls. For professionals in court operations, legal support or case administration, it develops practical workflows for filing validation, caseflow tracking, hearing readiness and records retention. Learners also practice notice coordination and performance reporting to strengthen traceability and identify administrative bottlenecks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work inside court operations, legal support services, or case administration and need to improve digital control, accuracy, and workflow discipline.
prerequisites: Participants should already have working knowledge of court or legal office procedures, document handling, and case administration workflows. Familiarity with electronic filing platforms, records management basics, and hearing coordination is recommended. No coding or programming is required, but you should be comfortable working with digital documents, spreadsheets, and process templates.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
